subject: Human Body
title: Brain Lateralization
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Brain Lateralization.

hook.text: The left brain controls the right body and the right brain controls the left. They're cross-wired.

buildup.text: Generally, the left hemisphere handles language, math, and logic. The right handles spatial awareness and music.

discovery.text: The corpus callosum bridges both halves with 200 million nerve fibers. It lets the hemispheres share information.

twist.text: The 'left brain vs right brain personality' myth is false. Both hemispheres work together for every complex task.

climax.text: Split-brain patients, with a severed corpus callosum, show each half can function semi-independently.

punchline.text: Two halves, one brain. Neither works well alone.

quiz.question: What is the corpus callosum?
options: A protective membrane around the brain
A fiber bridge connecting the two hemispheres
The outer layer of the cerebellum
